title: Mobile postpaid / telco contract exit
summary: Leaving Singapore with a postpaid mobile line still in contract — inventory handsets and add-ons, serve written cancel notice, and float early-termination plus final-bill cash before SIM and Singpass factors change.

sections.title: Inventory lines, handsets, and add-ons
sections.body: Postpaid plans often bundle handset instalments, roaming packs, family share-lines, and insurance. Before you change SIM or Singpass factors, export the contract summary and note remaining months, device balance, and which numbers still receive OTP. A “keep SIM for OTP” plan is a different path from full cancel — decide which numbers must stay live through fly week.
bullets: List every postpaid number, handset instalment, and share-line still billed
Export contract months remaining and device balance while the app still opens
Decide cancel-vs-keep for OTP numbers before packing week

sections.title: Serve written cancel inside the notice window
sections.body: Telcos rarely treat a WhatsApp “stop next month” as notice. Submit cancel through the official channel, keep the ticket ID, and ask for the projected ETF and final-bill date in writing. Sketch cash on /tools/mobile-contract-etf-float so packing week does not raid the movers pot.
bullets: File cancel through the official app or store desk and keep the ticket ID
Ask for written ETF and final-bill timing before you fly

sections.title: Clear or transfer handset balances
sections.body: Device instalments can outlive the service plan. Confirm whether paying off the handset early reduces ETF, and whether a transfer to another account is allowed. Photograph IMEI stickers before any store visit so the wrong device is not billed as unreturned.
bullets: Confirm remaining device balance separately from plan ETF
Ask whether early device payoff changes the ETF quote
Photograph IMEI labels before store handovers

sections.title: Mobile cancel vs fibre broadband ETF
sections.body: Home fibre and mobile postpaid are different contracts. Do not apply a fibre ETF sketch to a mobile line, and do not assume one cancel ticket covers both. Sequence fibre and mobile exits on the same calendar only when the same adult can sit both desks.
bullets: Do not assume one cancel ticket covers home fibre and mobile
Keep one adult free for telco callbacks during notice week

sections.title: OTP, Singpass, and number port hygiene
sections.body: Banks, Singpass, and clinic portals often still SMS the Singapore number. If you must keep a line for OTP, use the keep-SIM path explicitly. If you cancel, migrate critical OTPs first — then change Singpass factors — so you are not locked out mid-archive week.
bullets: Migrate critical OTP numbers before full cancel when possible
Cross-check /tools/sim-otp-keep if a number must stay live
Sequence Singpass factor changes after telco export is done

sections.title: Same-week stack with bank and leaving playbooks
sections.body: Final telco bills, bank statement archives, and leaving checklists often share one fortnight. Sequence portal downloads while the number still works, then cancel, then physical leaving tasks — so OTP-gated archives are not trapped behind a dead SIM.
bullets: Put telco cancel, OTP migration, and bank archive on one calendar
Pair with /journeys/bank-exit-closure when SGD rails are also closing
Hold ETF float separate from movers and pharmacy cash pots
